evidence_snippets: The following screenshot shows an example of a Logs tab: Configure third-party integrations If you open the details pane for a third-party integration you haven't installed, then the panel indicates that you have no dashboards or configured resources for the integration.

This document describes the Cloud Monitoring Integrations page, a central location from which you can manage and review the status of Monitoring integrations with Google services and with your third-party applications.
